'''Xaul''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[prisoner]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] that served time on [[Narkina 5]]. He worked in [[Unit Five-Two-D]], at [[Table Five]].<ref name="Episode 8" /> In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> he [[Death|perished]] during an [[Narkina 5 prison escape|uprising]] of the [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex]]'s prisoners.<ref name="Episode 10">{{Andor|One Way Out}}</ref>
